== * Among his celebrity fans is K-Pop idol [[wikipedia:en:Sunmi|Sunmi]] (Lee Sun-mi) of [[wikipedia:en:Wonder Girls|Wonder Girls]], who made a viral Instagram post of herself modeling his jersey like a dress.[https://twitter.com/DamwonGaming/status/1284862965175345153 DWG go with Sunmi: "I'm the ShowMaker"] Damwon Gaming on Twitter * He decided on his summoner name, ShowMaker, because he wanted to put on a great show.[https://www.facebook.com/lolesports/videos/2000748180089690 How ShowMaker found his Summoner Name] ''facebook.com'' * Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on August 28th, 2021 ** The 17th player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK, after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], [[Deft]], [[Teddy]], [[Ruler]], [[Bdd]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)| Ghost]], [[Peanut]], [[Chovy]] and [[Fly (Song Yong-jun)|Fly]] ** Is the fastest (days since debut) player in the LCK to achieve 1000 kills. ** His 1000th kill in the LCK was on [[T1]]'s Jungler [[Oner]] in the [[LCK 2021 Summer Playoffs|LCK 2021 Summer Playoffs Finals]] with {{ci|LeBlanc}} * Reached 1500 kills in the LCK on July 7, 2023. ** The 13th player to reach 1500 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Teddy]], [[Bdd]], [[Chovy]], [[Peanut]], and [[Aiming]]. * Reached 2000 kills in the LCK on April 25th, 2025. ** The 8th player to reach 2000 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Teddy]], [[Bdd]], [[Chovy]], and [[Aiming]]. ** His 2000th in the LCK was on [[T1]]'s top laner [[Doran (Choi Hyeon-joon)|Doran]] in [[LCK/2025 Season/Rounds 1-2|Round 1]] with {{ci|Sylas}}. ** Was the fourth mid laner (after [[Faker]], [[Bdd]] and [[Chovy]]) to reach 2000 LCK kills. * Reached 300 wins in [[LCK]] on July 21, 2023, becoming the 10th player to do so after [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[GorillA]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Peanut]], [[Bdd]], and [[Chovy]]. * Reached 400 wins in [[LCK]] on August 14, 2025, becoming the 10th player to do so after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Peanut]], Bdd, Chovy, Lehends, Kiin, Canyon, and Ruler. * Reached 500 games in the LCK on February 29, 2024, becoming the 14th player to do so. * Reached 600 games in the LCK on April 20, 2025, becoming the 10th player to do so, after Faker, Deft, Bdd, Peanut, Kiin, Teddy, Chovy, [[Lehends]], and Ruler. * Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on June 15, 2024. ** Was the 17th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK. * Reached 4000 assists in the LCK on September 18, 2025. ** Was the 14th player to reach 4000 assists in the LCK. * He is known for his reaction "Wow! League of Legends" when he realises that [[K'Sante]] is so OP[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y2YVLbQSdRA Showmaker already has ENOUGH of this Season] ''youtube.com'' and a clip of when he died to him listing all of his stats and abilities.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fW69GYmiHBM Showmaker loses his mind over K'Sante] ''youtube.com'' * Is ISFJ on the MBTI scale.[https://youtu.be/qYHWSzXWst4?t=954 LCK LANEMATES - MID EP.2 | 2024 LCK Spring Split] ''youtube.com'' * He is a big fan of European football players, as he has celebrated LCK victories by striking famous poses from players like [[wikipedia:en:Mbappé|Mbappé]] and [[wikipedia:en:Viktor Gyökeres|Gyökeres]].[https://x.com/lolesports/status/1890716935672766609 LoL Esports' X Post] ''x.com''[https://x.com/lolesports/status/1923320788838408370 LoL Esports' X Post] ''x.com'' === Individual Awards === * LCK MVP x1 (Summer 2020) * LCK Player of the Split x1 (Spring 2021) * LCK Final MVP x1 (Summer 2021) * LCK 1st All-Pro Team x3 (Summer 2020, Spring 2021, Summer 2021) * LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x2 (Spring 2022, 2026) {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerShowmatchResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerResults1v1|show=overviewpage}} ==Media== {{PlayerMedia}} === Images === {{PlayerProfileGallery}} {{PlayerPageEnd}}
